result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行梯度更新或微调的情况下，以零样本、单样本和少样本方式在大量 NLP 数据集上评估其上下文学习能力 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，少样本设置下有时可与或偶尔超过此前最优的微调方法 [abstract][S1.p11]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。此外，GPT-3 能生成人类评估者难以与人类撰写文章区分的新闻文章样本 [abstract][S1.p12]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万条任务特定标注数据进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模标注数据限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少量示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model

method.text: 论文训练了 GPT-3，一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型，参数量比此前任何非稀疏语言模型多 10 倍 [abstract]。模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 个不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]；具体包括少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。任务涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI，以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成与定性任务 [S3.p3]。此外，作者还训练了从 1.25 亿到 130 亿参数的较小模型，以比较不同规模在三种设置下的表现 [S1.p16]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
For each task, we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions
In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks
we also train a series of smaller models (ranging from 125 million parameters to 13 billion parameters)

findings.text: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与或偶尔超过由微调模型保持的最优结果 [S1.p11]。例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2% [S1.p11]。GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术和仅看一次定义后在新句子中使用新词 [S1.p12]。同时，论文发现部分任务即使对 GPT-3 而言少样本表现仍然不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。在新闻生成上，人类评估者区分 GPT-3 生成文章与人类撰写文章的准确率仅略高于随机水平，约为 52% [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

evidence.quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3
This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC
mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档层面语义重复、长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。在比较类任务上，GPT-3 单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机，例如判断两个句子中同一词用法是否相同（WiC）或一句是否蕴含另一句（ANLI），以及部分阅读理解任务 [S5.p2]。作者还指出模型存在结构性限制，因为实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、回看比较两段内容或需要重读长文后生成极短答案的任务表现 [S5.p3]。此外，作者承认少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]；GPT-3 规模的模型推理成本高且不便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks
determining if two words are used the same way in a sentence, or if one sentence implies another (WIC and ANLI respectively)
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
This may include fill-in-the-blank tasks, tasks that involve looking back and comparing two pieces of content
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on
